notes.title: We're coming out on consoles!
notes.content:
Hello again, everyone!

We've got some great news for you and a new update for The Unexpected Quest.

Let's start with the first one. We're excited to announce that the game is now available on all platforms! The update will be released on Nintendo Switch on September 26th, and from September 27th it'll be available on the PlayStation Store for PS4 and PS5, as well as on the Microsoft Store for Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S. If you'd rather play from the comfort of your couch, it's time to embark on an adventure with the Dwarf Sailors!


 PlayStation Store
 Microsoft Store
 Nintendo Store

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/3b268d43c5ddaa5ad40f2b73d6718fd0e478457e.png

The new update adds Japanese localization of the game. We've translated everything, including the Compendium. We've improved the gamepad controls and updated the tutorial to match the new controls. We also fixed some bugs and reduced the size of the game, but who cares about megabytes nowadays?

Thanks for your attention, have a great weekend, and take care!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307670/The_Unexpected_Quest/

notes.title: Verified on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/a639bd45d320a22e7e0dad7fd324f8150a1e80be.gif

With the latest patch, our game has reached verified status for Steam Deck! We are very happy about this! We hope you will be interested in playing it in portable mode as well. 

In addition, there were these fixes:

 Some in-game text has been changed to match the way the game is played with the controller.
 Removed vertical sync in the game and added a frame limit option instead.
 Small changes to the Compendium, namely the wallpaper widget.

And as always, a big request you to you. If you have any problems with the game or suggestions about it, please write to us!

Thank you for your attention and have fun playing!

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 Is Here!
notes.content:
Long time no see, fellow Questers 📜  

we're coming to you with good news! The Unexpected Quest Version 1.2.3 is OUT NOW!
If its great title hasn't convinced you yet, we are certain its features will: 


 2 chapters with new gameplay and objects (in total, that's about an additional 1,5 hours of gameplay!)
 A compendium with detailed information about the game mechanics and the strategy guide
 8 downloadable wallpapers and 8 music videos from the game
 Access to concept art and some development videos
 Advanced options dialog with UI scaling and other improvements

Let us know what you think, but most importantly ... Have Fun!⚒️

notes.title: Happy Monday, Questers!
notes.content:
What a way to start the week: the Unexpected Quest update is out now!

This free update comes with additions to the ‘Graphics’, ‘Game’, and ‘Sound’ tab such as the highly requested disabling of characters mumbling during cinematics. It also introduces the new ‘Tales’ mode with the initial two tales focussing on battles. You are able to choose from 3 difficulty levels but beware … unlike in ‘Story’ mode, this time around you can lose. 

Want a list of the changes coming your way with the update? Well since you asked, here’s the full breakdown: 

Settings Dialog

 Tabs for different settings
 In the 'Graphics' tab, in addition to the image quality, it is now possible to change the screen resolution separately
 In the ‘Sound’ tab, it is now possible to disable the mumbling of characters during cinematics 
 In the ‘Game’ tab, you can now change the size of the interface 

Game

 After clicking on ‘Play’, we can choose a new mode – ‘Tales’

The ‘Tales’ Mode 

 Unlike in ‘Story’ mode, here you can lose
 The first 2 tales are dedicated to battles: The first one will have you fighting off waves of enemies every night whereas the second one challenges your ability to fight lots of enemies with few warriors at your disposal
 Choose from 3 difficulty levels


A little head’s up: The update is only available to for Windows users. 

Enjoy the update and let us know what you think! We can’t wait to hear from you!

Now, what are you waiting for? Happy questing and good luck! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/6123cfb7d4f1718e9dc14767150a181d1650edbd.gif

notes.title: December 8th Update & Thank you
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Just a quick message to say thanks to all for your great support since we launched The Unexpected Quest. We’ve been really pleased with all of your support, messages, and feedback on the game and it’s great to see so many people are enjoying it. 

Based on your feedback, we’ve made some changes and fixes to the game. Please find the patch notes below.

Fixes
1. HUD elements now change size according to the monitor's DPI. 
2. Characters running into the house now can be healed. 
3. If the game does not find a suitable localization, the English language will be set.
4. The towers were faster to determine that their guards were destroyed.

Also, for those who haven’t downloaded The Unexpected Quest, don’t forget you can try the Prologue for free from the link down below. 
here

Thanks for your amazing support and stay safe!

Cheers!

notes.title: Upgrade Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 

Today we will talk about upgrades. Upgrades will play a major role in your adventure, because if you don’t give proper maintenance to your tools and weapon you won’t be able to move forward. 

Now you might ask, but how do I upgrade my tools and weapons. It is thanks to the Forge, which we covered in our previous update about buildings. You can check it out here.
You will have to go through another way to get the best gear possible, but we don’t want to spoil you everything 😉

Now let's not waste any time and lets get started!

Upgrade levels
You can level up your gear by two levels through the forge. Thanks to a predefined amount of gold, you will be able to upgrade your gear to make it stronger.

Here’s what it looks like in game:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/559f187a24bcd9e2fa4e3bc08dda62c217884875.png

Upgrade to level 2 and 3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/b7dd68b8e79d6f0d9f187590043c7c8d2e6c360a.png



Tools upgrade
Tools are one of the two thing you can upgrade. By upgrading them you will be able to clear bigger debris, build different types of bridges, and thus unlocking access to a bigger part of the map, in order to fulfill your Unexpected Quest (ha!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/b4b5bdc943a56bc1788b162f08a8ba77fcccf317.png

Upgrade tools to level 2 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/368c5df6db31c82a3eb4202bb9d84a73698bcbac.png



Weapon upgrade
Now if you want to defeat stronger enemies you will also need stronger weapons. While you can defeat strong enemies with brute force, you will waste a lot of your precious resources hiring new soldiers. This is why a good weapon leads to victory! 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e8f9028b8d0684ef6ca4bbfaf1f3fd5e59a72bdf.png

Upgrade weapons to level 2 and 3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/59e11554f88c4189676b6d5ba2d3e5f1ed6b2dbe.png



And that’s it for this week! Remember to always upgrade your tools and weapons, and victory will be yours!

notes.title: Units Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

Today we would like to talk to you about the units in Unexpected Quest.
Without units you won’t be able to do anything, be it creating new building or fighting enemies, which means that you won’t be able to improve your settlement, which is something you don’t want!

Now let us get started and take a deeper look into what units are available in Unexpected Quest.


Villagers
Dwarves are non-fighting units. Essential to the life of your settlement, they will be the one who will collect resources, open chests, loot items, create new buildings and much more. Make sure to protect them and regularly acquire more so your settlement is well-maintained!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/baf8666aa8aec67f2944d059f4d411fbe47b3eb6.gif


Swordsman
Swordsman are melee fighters. Thanks to their swords they deal a lot of damage close range, and will be the fighting units you will use first and the most throughout the various chapters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/2865eb80964f9d499ba66a6815b6fcc5a51bb461.gif


Archer and Mages
Archer and Mages are two ranged units. While the Archer deals physical damage, the Mage will deal magical damage, so make sure to use the proper unit depending on the foes you will face!
PS: this is a brand new clip of a new enemy, send to us directly by the developers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/945139b77c98904e537d6268b1245331031b5f6a.gif


Clerics
Clerics are support units that will heal your injured soldiers. Make sure to always have one if you can! Apparently they can also activate Altars, but we have no idea what this means, maybe you will be able to find out in the game?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/c57689e54e19719f935305c376c467829ceef97d.gif


And that’s it for this week!
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Buildings Update 2
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Today we would like to introduce you to another kind of buildings.
Unlike the buildings we showed you in the previous update, those edifices can only be created on very specific places. Those are usually locked away by a character, puzzle or quest that you have to solve before accessing the area and progressing in the story!

We will now see together what they are, and what’s their use!

Barracks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/8563eb563273f06ad456b91f61ae0728c3b01428.gif

Barracks are used to hire soldiers. There are 3 kinds of fighting units: Swordsman, Archer and Mage. You will be able to learn more about them in a future update!
However, you can only hire Swordsmen at first, you will need to create special buildings to hire Archers and Mages. But no worries! We will talk about those in the upcoming lines of this update.


Archery Range

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/516961b35e15e54e6b9a86f2cfeb105d75b2cb7f.gif

Archery ranges will allow you to hire Archers. Without an Archery Range, you won’t be able to hire anything else than Swordsman!


Mage’s Tower

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/2916c0a62396e4d4ad75ab06009a4148455d59a3.gif

Mage’s Towers will allow you to hire Mages. Without a Mage’s Towers, you won’t be able to hire anything else than Swordsman!


Shrine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e19c5722ed1f1aade0921a2224995ac7953eaac3.gif

Shrines will allow you to hire Clerics! They’re very important support units, so don’t forget to build a shrine as soon as you can - they are really important for quests! However, they are not a battle unit like the other three classes.

And that’s it for this week! There are still other buildings for you to discover, but unlike those we just introduced you they can’t be built just anywhere.
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Buildings Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
Today we would like to talk to you about the buildings in Unexpected Quest.
Buildings are the most important part of your growth, and we will go through every building available in Unexpected Quest.
Make sure to build a prospering settlement!

Houses
The most basic building. They allow you to control 2 more characters. The legend says that at some point you might unlock a Large House that will allow you to control 4 more characters, but we will let you discover it 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/bfb9915a636e96a3c75bab7dbdcae9661fc4e916.gif

Mill 
The mill will become your primary source of Food. It will periodically produce 60 units of Food, but you will be able to increase it to 200 if you manage to find the right item.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/ad1efae0be03fc24f821a1d05ad6576976624628.gif

Sawmill
Like the mill, the sawmill will become your primary source of Wood. It will periodically produce 60 units of Wood, but just like with the mill, you will be able to increase it to 200 if you manage to find the right item.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/e6abfa1044007861bbf48f91e468fb5d73341311.gif

And that’s it for this week! There are still other buildings for you to discover, but unlike those we just introduced you they can’t be built just anywhere.
See you next week with another Unexpected Quest update!

notes.title: Resources Update
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!
Today we would like to talk to you about the resources in The Unexpected Quest.
Resources are an important part of every management game, and the Unexpected Quest is no exception.
Now let’s go together through what resources are available, how to acquire them, and what their use is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/de44cff7950777d933a4bed7c36308175bb52606.png

Wood
Wood will be the resource you will use in order to build new buildings, like houses, mills or sawmills. Fundamental to every construction, you can acquire it if you’ve built a sawmill, or by removing wooden debris if you acquire the right item!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/d71153f9e74fa18fd4dda65c148b2d7e8d29f260.gif

Food
Food is a resource that you will need for most of your actions. Removing debris, building some buildings, and most importantly, getting more workers or soldiers, it all needs food. In order to get food, make sure to build a mill, since that will be your main source of food until later in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/823ceb24dfe072a5786d3f1fb1d541ec64603bfb.gif

Gold
Gold is the most important resource you will need if you want to upgrade your settlement. Used to recruit and upgrade units, as well as get stronger tools and weapons for your people. Without gold you won’t be able to prosper. You can get gold by completing quests, removing debris (with the right item equipped), or by selling food or wood at the market!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/732726434bedaf6b90a52cb7ab9a33f92e352d46.png

Population
The population represent the amount of playable unit you control, be it civilian or armed units.
Make sure to build enough houses so you can recruit new units at the town hall or the barracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/9dcd2621665c32154d1d2a2be7a39acf9db01cf0.gif

Barracks: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37711068/8662f94c4a045f878185b65480d766077a8337fa.png

And that’s it for today! See you next week with a new update!
